execution_batches.description: Prepare the runtime bridge refactor and the productive slot-write ownership without touching final validation yet.
Refactor the workflow and consumer error contract so ordered execution, retry semantics, and failure auditability are correct.
Replace the old queue consumer topology in infrastructure and align tests with the new native bridge.
Produce final reviewer-facing docs while the implementation is stabilizing locally.
Run quality gates and close the remediation with local proof that the new architecture is coherent.

tasks.title: Make pending-record productive writes own dispatch-slot metadata
outputs: A productive pending-record write path that persists dispatchSlot, dispatchSlotPk, and dispatchSortKey automatically
exit_criteria: The codebase has one authoritative place where new pending records receive dispatch-slot metadata.
The stable slot-routing algorithm remains deterministic and aligned with phase 3.
New pending records are immediately queryable by dispatch-slot-index without manual enrichment.

tasks.title: Prepare the runtime to remove Orchestrator Lambda from the queue-consumer path
outputs: A clear code and infrastructure boundary ready for SQS FIFO -> EventBridge Pipe -> Step Functions Express
exit_criteria: The existing queue-consumer assumptions are isolated and identified.
The workflow input can be constructed without depending on the Orchestrator Lambda runtime path.
No producer contract change is introduced in this preparation step.

tasks.title: Refactor the state machine to Express mode with explicit workflow normalization and strict retry/catch rules
outputs: A Step Functions Express definition that preserves workflow input, computes operational metadata, and retries only transient failures
exit_criteria: The workflow type is Express.
The workflow no longer relies on an external orchestrator to enrich TTL metadata.
Retry covers TransientApiError and States.Timeout only.
TerminalApiError is routed directly to the terminal failure path.
States.TaskFailed is not present in the retry block.

tasks.title: Refactor consumer-side error propagation so the workflow can persist the real provider status code
outputs: Consumer errors that carry a structured JSON cause with statusCode, message, category, providerId, and recordId
exit_criteria: Transient and terminal classified errors preserve the real provider status code.
The workflow can parse caught error causes deterministically.
Unexpected generic errors continue to be wrapped as transient unless explicitly reclassified.

tasks.title: Persist terminal and exhausted failures with parsed dynamic provider status codes
outputs: Workflow-owned failure persistence paths that store the real provider status code instead of fixed placeholders
exit_criteria: Terminal failure rows no longer hardcode 400.
Exhausted transient failure rows no longer hardcode 504 when the real code is available.
Failure rows preserve category, message, providerId, recordId, and processedAt consistently.

tasks.title: Replace the SQS-consuming Orchestrator Lambda with EventBridge Pipe in CDK
outputs: Infrastructure configured as SQS FIFO ordered source -> EventBridge Pipe -> Step Functions Express REQUEST_RESPONSE
exit_criteria: The provider queue is no longer consumed by a Lambda event source mapping in runtime.
The stack defines an AWS::Pipes::Pipe with source batch size 1.
The pipe target uses synchronous invocation semantics against the Express workflow.
CloudWatch logging remains available for operational debugging.

tasks.title: Update tests and fixtures to the new runtime bridge and productive slot ownership model
outputs: Passing unit and CDK expectations aligned with EventBridge Pipe, Express workflow, strict retries, and productive slot materialization
exit_criteria: CDK tests validate the Pipe and the Express workflow topology.
State machine tests validate the new retry/catch semantics and dynamic failure persistence.
Pending-record tests validate productive slot materialization.
Obsolete orchestrator-path assertions are removed or replaced.

tasks.title: Create ARCHITECTURE.md with final Mermaid diagram and architectural rationale
outputs: A root-level ARCHITECTURE.md explaining the final runtime and the key remediation decisions
exit_criteria: The document includes a Mermaid diagram of the final runtime path.
The document explains why EventBridge Pipe replaced the Orchestrator Lambda.
The document explains retry, audit, and productive slot decisions in reviewer-friendly language.

tasks.title: Document requirement-to-solution traceability for the challenge deliverable
outputs: A concise traceability narrative mapping challenge requirements to runtime components and proof points
exit_criteria: Each core challenge requirement is mapped to a concrete solution behavior.
The traceability points to code or tests where practical.
The final documentation can be read independently of the phase-by-phase spec history.

tasks.title: Run build, targeted tests, and final local validation for the remediation package
outputs: A locally validated remediation set ready for implementation review or AWS proof-path execution
exit_criteria: npm run build passes.
Relevant Jest suites pass with the new topology and behavior.
The repository contains functional spec, technical spec, todos, and architecture documentation aligned to the implemented changes.
The remediation package is coherent enough to move into AWS validation or review.
